episodes.title: eXposed
episodes.summary: City prosecutor Reed Strucker discovers that his two teenage children Lauren and Andy are mutants... and that the government will stop at nothing to capture them. To save his children, Reed and his wife Caitlin must seek out the mutant underground and obtain their help.

episodes.title: rX
episodes.summary: Clarice's powers run out of control, threatening the Mutant Underground. Meanwhile, Jace threatens Reed, Lorna deals with life in prison, and Caitlin helps Marcos get the medicine they need for Clarice.

episodes.title: eXodus
episodes.summary: Reed has second thoughts about selling out the Mutant Underground to Sentinel Services. Meanwhile, Dreamer takes extreme measures to help Clarice focus her portal-generating power, and Caitlin turns to her brother for help.

episodes.title: eXit strategy
episodes.summary: Marcos turns to a former girlfriend for information on the convoy that is taking Reed and Lorna to a secure facility. Meanwhile, John and the others plan a rescue, but things go amiss when it turns out that Jace has a mutant of his own.

episodes.title: boXed in
episodes.summary: Lorna and Marcos capture Jace and interrogate him. Meanwhile, Reed offers to draw the police away to prove his loyalty to the mutant cause, while Caitlin, Lauren, and Andy try to save a dying mutant.

episodes.title: got your siX
episodes.summary: When Clarice leaves the underground, Marcos and John come up with an alternate plan to break into the Federal building... involving Reed and Andy. Meanwhile, Caitlin objects when Lorna starts training Lauren in how to use her powers offensively, and Jace increases his efforts to hunt down the mutant undeground.

episodes.title: eXtreme measures
episodes.summary: Carmen calls in her "favor" with Marcos, who tries to hide it from Lorna. Meanwhile, Reed finds out about Wes' past, and Roderick introduces Jace to the Hounds.

episodes.title: threat of eXtinction
episodes.summary: John and the others capture a spy who may know the location of Trask Industries. Meanwhile, Reed confronts his father Otto, who reveals the history of the Strucker family.

episodes.title: outfoX
episodes.summary: Esme comes up with a plan to break into the Trask facility and rescue the prisoners, but it requires Andy and Lauren to go on a side mission that requires them to use their newfound joint power.

episodes.title: eXploited
episodes.summary: Esme puts her own plan into effect, convincing the Struckers to ask Jace to transfer the prisoners at Trask. Meanwhile, Roderick tests the extent of Andy and Lauren's powers.

episodes.title: 3 X 1
episodes.summary: The Frost triplets suggest to the Underground that they ally together, without revealing their connection to the Hellfire Club. Meanwhile, Lorna's powers continue to grow, and the Struckers prepare to leave the country.

episodes.title: eXtraction
episodes.summary: The Frost Triplets convince the Mutant Underground to help them abduct Roderick from a Humanity First Summit. Meanwhile, the Struckers track down Ellen when they discover that she may know who Otto was talking with about his X-Gene research.

episodes.title: X-roads
episodes.summary: Jace and SS find the Underground HQ and launch an attack. Meanwhile, Lorna and Andy decide which side that they're on.

episodes.title: eMergence
episodes.summary: Six months after the events in Atlanta--and after Reeva Payge takes control of the Hellfire Club--Sentinel Services escalates its raids on suspected mutants. Caitlin and Marcos go a shady mutant hacker to get info on Andy and Lorna's location, and Lorna's pregnancy approaches.

episodes.title: unMoored
episodes.summary: John contacts Evangeline, the mutant lawyer who recruited him as leader of the Underground, for help tracing the Inner Circle financial records. Andy has difficulty focusing after he has a dream of a Lauren terrified of him, and Marcos throws a celebration for the daughter that he's never seen.

episodes.title: coMplications
episodes.summary: John and Clarice seek out Erg, Reed and Lauren go on a supply run, and Marcos has an unexpected reunion with his wife and daughter.

episodes.title: outMatched
episodes.summary: John, Caitlin, and Marcos go to see Wire and convince him to help them track down the Inner Circle. The trail leads the underground to a mental hospital where Marcos and Lauren have to face off against Andy.

episodes.title: afterMath
episodes.summary: When the Frosts are unable to convince their new mutant to help them, Andy tries a different approach. Clarice and Marcos go to the Morlocks with the mental hospital escapees, while Jace makes some new friends.

episodes.title: iMprint
episodes.summary: Lorna balks at Reeva holding back the nature of their mission, and Esme tries to win her confidence. Jace sets a trap for the Mutant Underground, and John starts training Reed in using his new mutant power.

episodes.title: no Mercy
episodes.summary: Reeva and the Inner Circle launch their attack on Creed Financial, but things don't go entirely as Reeva planned. John and the others try to get Reed to somewhere safe, while Caitlin learns from Otto's files about someone who may be able to help her husband control his new powers.

episodes.title: the dreaM
episodes.summary: Lorna remembers her roots as she considers what to do with Dawn as anti-mutant violence breaks out across the nation. The Struckers find a potential ally who can treat Reed, and John and Clarice track Rebecca after she abandons the Inner Circle.

episodes.title: gaMe changer
episodes.summary: Andy is forced to rescue Rebecca from the Inner Circle and tries to take her out, but Rebecca has other plans. Meanwhile, the Struckers realize what Madeline is up to, and Clarice and John disagree about John's approach to the mutant war that is coming.

episodes.title: eneMy of My eneMy
episodes.summary: To rescue John, the Underground has no choice but to turn to two former members--Lorna and Andy--for help. But the reunion isn't as happy as planned.

episodes.title: meMento
episodes.summary: Lauren develops new powers after listening to a music box that belonged to Andreas Von Strucker, while Marcos ends up making contact with Lorna again. Jace is forced to make a choice when a Purifier raid goes wrong, and Evangeline calls John to let her know the next step that she's taking.

episodes.title: hoMe
episodes.summary: Evangeline calls a summit of the Underground leaders, but Reeva has other plans. Lorna continues to put herself at risk passing on information to Marcos, and Caitlin and Lauren go to see Caitlin's brother Daniel to find out what he knows about the extremists.

episodes.title: teMpted
episodes.summary: The Frosts attempt to get to Lauren through Andy's dreams, while Clarice calls Caitlin and Marcos to the Morlock tunnels when Glow is wounded while stealing supplies. Meanwhile, a confused and dazed Lauren wanders off on her own and Reed makes a confession to her.

episodes.title: calaMity
episodes.summary: Reeva finds the person that she believes is responsible for Max's death and exacts bloody revenge. Benedict gives Jace the location of the Morlocks and instructions to wipe them out.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: Lauren and Caitlin flee the police, and Reed and Marcos come after them. John deals with losing Clarice, and Lorna tries to convince Andy to come with her.

episodes.title: oMens
episodes.summary: After losing Andy and Lorna, Reeva sends the Frosts to bring her a new weapon to destroy Sentinel Services. Reed contemplates the past as he considers a sacrifice in the present, and John comes face-to-face with the man who killed Clarice.
